tavily.text:
To install urllib3, you can use pip with the command `$ python -m pip install urllib3`. Alternatively, you can download the latest source code from the GitHub repository at https://github.com/urllib3/urllib3. For usage and reference documentation, visit urllib3.readthedocs.io. The sources also mention that urllib3 can be installed with pip and provide the command for that. The GitHub repository contains various files including README.md, LICENSE.txt, and pyproject.toml.
Much of the Python ecosystem already uses urllib3 and you should too.

## Installing

urllib3 can be installed with pip:

```
$ python -m pip install urllib3
```

Alternatively, you can grab the latest source code from GitHub:

```
cd.
```

## Getting Started

urllib3 is easy to use:

```
>>> import urllib3>>> resp = urllib3 request "GET"" resp status 200>>> resp datab"User-agent: \nDisallow: /deny\n" \n \n
```

```

```
